How does Tantan work?

"Unfortunately, you cannot go back. Think before you decide whether to like or pass a profile, make sure you’re not missing a great opportunity.
Luckily, there’s always new users. So don’t worry too much about the one that got away, there’s plenty more to come."
I’m out of people to browse through. How do I get more?

"Sorry to hear that. Here are some tips you can try out:
1- Have you been sending out Likes? To increase your odds, the more people you like, the larger the possibility that someone will like you back. Try adjusting your preferences and step up your game.
2- Your account may still be under review. This means that you won’t see any new profiles until your account has been validated by our review team.
To avoid running into these issues, please make sure to use authentic photos and repsect our community guidelines.
If your account is under review, a badge will be shown under our Help Center homepage. Please contact us for further questions if you see this."
Be original, start with a funny opener or give the other person a compliment. It can be on anything, their hair, the way they dress, etc.
Remember, people love talking about themselves. So, what was it that caught your eye when you liked them? Ask them about it!
How does Tantan work?
For every profile card, you can either like or pass.
"If you like what you see, tap the Like button. Don't worry, they won’t know unless they like you back."
"If someone isn't your type, tap the Pass button. You won't see their profile again and they won't know that you've passed on them."
"When someone you liked has liked you back, well done, you've got a match! Now you can start chatting."
"I'm out of profiles to browse through?"
We get it, you love our app. Good news is that, new users may be signing up for Tantan as you read this sentence! Still, think carefully before you make a decision to not miss any great opportunity.
